description.summary: surfaces and regions kept from agents and capture

protocol.description:
Any client may mark a surface, or regions of it, as sensitive. An `agent_hidden` region is masked in every frame an agent lease captures; a `capture_hidden` region is masked in every capture the compositor serves (screenshots, screencasts and agent leases alike), including the ones made for trusted clients such as the desktop's portal and the shell: no capture path is unmasked. The person still sees it on screen.
Not served yet: casement does not advertise this global on any connection today, so a client that looks for it finds nothing and its regions are not masked. The masking above applies from the day the server lands, to every capture the compositor makes.
This protocol is a draft. Until it is declared stable, version 1 may change in place with every client and the server updated together.

entry.name: already_constructed
entry.summary: the surface already has a quire_sensitive_surface_v1 object

request.name: get_sensitive

description.summary: the sensitivity object of a surface

request.description: A surface has at most one; asking for a second while the first exists raises `already_constructed`.

interface.name: quire_sensitive_surface_v1
interface.description: All state is double-buffered and applied on the surface's next wl_surface.commit. A surface without this object, or after `clear`, is `normal` everywhere. Destroying the object clears its state on the next commit.

description.summary: who may not see the content

request.name: set_whole
request.description: The whole surface takes `level`; regions set earlier are dropped.

request.name: set_regions
request.description: Adds `region` (surface-local) at `level` to the regions already set. `normal` raises `bad_level`: `clear` returns the surface to normal.

request.name: clear
request.description: Drops the whole-surface level and every region.

request.name: destroy
request.description: The surface returns to normal on its next commit.
